name: ChannelMAX
description_en:
ChannelMAX is primarily an Amazon repricing and seller-operations service. Its inventory synchronization module distributes stock quantities across marketplaces; related offerings include FBA refund management and conversion of non-Amazon orders to Amazon multi-channel fulfillment.

For inventory selection, evaluate the synchronization module on its own terms. The documentation describes periodic updates and explicitly acknowledges delay, so it should not be treated as instantaneous stock reservation or a complete warehouse system.
description_zh:
ChannelMAX 主要提供 Amazon 调价和卖家运营服务。库存同步模块将数量分发到多个市场，相关服务还包括 FBA 赔偿管理及将非 Amazon 订单转入 Amazon 多渠道履约。

库存选型应单独评估同步模块。文档说明周期更新并明确承认延迟，因此不能将其视为即时库存预留或完整仓库系统。

core_features.explanation_en: Central quantities are propagated to marketplaces; parent/child mappings can represent the same physical item under multiple ASINs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 中心数量分发至市场；父子映射可表示同一实物对应多个 ASIN。

core_features.explanation_en: The inventory page describes allocation profiles and adjustment reports with time, channel, listing and transaction information.
core_features.explanation_zh: 库存页描述渠道分配配置及包含时间、渠道、刊登和交易信息的调整报表。

sections.title_en: Map shared physical stock before publishing quantities
sections.title_zh: 发布数量前映射共享实物库存
sections.en: A merchant listing the same item under several marketplace identifiers should first map those listings to a central SKU. Test a sale on one channel and inspect the quantity adjustment on the others. Bundles need component mapping; the official example combines a camera and battery. Supplier feed inputs require usable quantity and cost files rather than merely a supplier name.
sections.zh: 同一商品具有多个市场标识时，应先将刊登映射到中心 SKU，再测试一个渠道售出后其他渠道的数量调整。套装需要组件映射，官方示例为相机和电池组合。供应商数据输入需要可用的数量与成本文件，不能仅填写供应商名称。

sections.title_en: Keep a buffer for synchronization delay
sections.en: The stock page says real-time synchronization is impossible and warns about cancellation risk. The pricing page describes sales tracking every 30 minutes; other public wording mentions 15–30 minutes. Allocation profiles can publish less than total stock on a channel. Test concurrent last-unit orders and confirm the effective interval rather than relying on the repricer’s faster update claims.
sections.zh: 库存页说明无法做到真正实时同步，并提示取消订单风险。价格页描述每 30 分钟跟踪销售，其他公开文字提及 15–30 分钟。分配配置可向渠道发布低于总库存的数量。应测试并发购买最后一件商品并确认实际周期，不能套用调价器更快的更新宣传。

sections.title_en: Separate repricing, stock sync and refund fees
sections.title_zh: 区分调价、库存同步与赔偿收费
sections.en: Inventory Sync is listed as an additional $24.99 monthly for 2,500 SKUs. Repricing starts at $34.99 monthly for 500 SKUs, with larger plans and different speeds. Amazon MCF/eBay service is another $24.99 monthly; listings beyond 100 incur a stated one-time $50 per 100. RefundMAX charges 15% of recovered amounts. These separate charges must not be combined into a single universal entry price. Cancellation wording requests 30 days’ notice.
sections.zh: Inventory Sync 标价为额外每月 $24.99、2,500 SKU；调价服务从每月 $34.99、500 SKU 起，较大方案与更新速度不同。Amazon MCF/eBay 服务另收每月 $24.99，超过 100 个刊登时每增加 100 个注明一次性 $50。RefundMAX 按追回金额收 15%。不能将这些独立收费混为统一起价；取消条款要求提前 30 天通知。

sections.en: The relevant buyer is a marketplace seller with stable SKU mapping and a willingness to manage delayed quantity updates. It is a weaker documented fit for bin-level picking, manufacturing or lot-traceability requirements. Confirm channel authorization, feed failures and the stock-sync prerequisite subscription commercially. None of the marketplace connections or refund submissions were exercised.
sections.zh: 适合对象是 SKU 映射稳定、能够管理延迟数量更新的市场卖家。对于仓位拣货、制造或批次追溯需求，已读资料支持较弱。应向销售确认渠道授权、数据源失败处理及库存同步所需基础订阅。未实际连接市场或提交赔偿申请。
